description: This file implements screen capture functionality for Realtek hardware using DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) APIs. It includes initialization, screen info retrieval, screen capture, and cleanup functions for handling DRM resources and framebuffer data.

classes.name: DRMScreenCapture
classes.description: A structure representing the screen capture handle containing a context for DRM interactions.

classes.name: DRMContext
classes.description: A structure holding DRM file descriptor, kms context, and offset for framebuffer mapping.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_Init
methods.description: Initializes the screen capture handle and context, allocating necessary memory.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_GetScreenInfo
methods.description: Retrieves current screen information by opening DRM device and querying plane/framebuffer details.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_ScreenCapture
methods.description: Captures the current screen content into the provided output buffer by mapping framebuffer memory.

methods.name: DRMScreenCapture_Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes DRM device, and frees memory associated with the handle.
